Extended descriptions

aria-details on an image links it to one or more extended descriptions, surfaced as links. A target that is a hyperlink with a usable href links to its destination, titled by its aria-label or its text content; any other target is linked to in place, titled only by its aria-label. The attribute is honored on the image itself only, and a suppressed image gets no extended descriptions.

Extended descriptions
#details-multi-second
#details-multi-first

aria-details is a single ID reference in ARIA 1.2 and an ID reference list since ARIA 1.3; the list handling is kept for forward compatibility. EPUB validates against ARIA 1.2, so this markup is deliberately invalid: epubcheck rejects the space-separated list, and the error is in the baseline.
